title: USDE vs ENA: How Closely StablecoinX Stock Has Tracked ENA
headline: How closely has StablecoinX's stock tracked ENA?
name: USDE against ENA tracking review
description: StablecoinX's stock, USDE, moved the same way as ENA on 50 of 72 days to October 8, 2026, with a 0.64 correlation of daily moves at the 4 pm close.
imageAlt: Two panels. Left, USDE's 72 daily moves against ENA's, from the June 26 close to the October 8 close, with a fitted line of slope 1.37. Right, mNAV at the 4 pm close, from 0.37× on June 26 to a low of 0.13× on July 24 and a high of 0.52× on September 25.
